verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.spline.design/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index that links to Markdown pages. A second probe confirms per-page .md versions of the docs (e.g. what-is-spline.md) are served, and many cited doc URLs use this .md form, so agents can ingest the docs directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other agent-specific usage guidance, and no independent or community corroboration of agents consuming these docs in practice.
